page_title: FIO 0-3 NAP | Fiorentina v Napoli 04/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:10.
90+2' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Meret, who smothers the ball.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
89' Mathias Olivera is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
89' Substitution. Stanislav Lobotka makes way for Billy Gilmour (Napoli).
87' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
87' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) jumps into a tackle and Gianluca Manganiello signals a foul.
86' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola will be replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
86' Here comes a substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for David Neres.
85' Napoli hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
83' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
81' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
79' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Yacine Adli and he is replaced by Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina).
79' A substitution has been made. Lucas Beltran is replaced by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina).
79' The foul by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
78' Fiorentina quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
78' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
75' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
75' Fiorentina keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
73' Here is a change. Rolando Mandragora is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
73' Substitution. Romelu Lukaku makes his way off the pitch and Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) comes on as his replacement.
72' Alex Meret (Napoli) is able to continue to play.
71' The game is interrupted now, Alex Meret (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
70' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post.
68' 0 - 3 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Scott McTominay (Napoli), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:3.
67' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:3.
65' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
63' David Neres (Napoli) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
61' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
61' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
61' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alex Meret with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
59' The referee blows his whistle as Mathias Olivera (Napoli) was too aggressive in his challenge.
59' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) replaces Matias Moreno.
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fabiano Parisi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Robin Gosens (Fiorentina).
56' 6:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
54' 0 - 2 Goal! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for David de Gea to commit before slotting the penalty low into the middle of the goal.
54' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is going to take the penalty!
53' Matias Moreno (Fiorentina) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli are awarded a penalty kick!

53' Ambitious effort from Scott McTominay (Napoli). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
51' Half-chance! Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) plays a pass into the box, but Alex Meret reacts well to snuff out the attack.
50' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
49' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Moise Kean (Fiorentina) heads on.
46' The whistle blows and Gianluca Manganiello starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
43' Flag up against Moise Kean (Fiorentina). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
42' Fabiano Parisi plays a lofted ball into Dodo (Fiorentina) near the penalty spot, but the ball flies off the top of his head and goes high over the bar.
40' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
39' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
39' A snap shot by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Alex Meret produces a good save to thwart him.
38' The goal by Fiorentina is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
37' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The Fiorentina players aren’t happy.
35' Goal! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:1.
35' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
33' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
33' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
32' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

29' 0 - 1 David Neres (Napoli) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. David de Gea is just a bystander as the ball flies under the crossbar. The score is 0:1.
28' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle as Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
26' David Neres (Napoli) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
24' David Neres (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
22' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
21' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play.
21' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
20' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
18' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) drives a shot towards the bottom left corner from inside the box, but David de Gea leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
17' Fiorentina are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
15' A goal, which was scored by Mathias Olivera (Napoli), was disallowed due to offside.
15' David Neres (Napoli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
13' Gianluca Manganiello couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Scott McTominay (Napoli) and blew his whistle.
12' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) but poses no threat.
12' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
10' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) makes a strong challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
9' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
8' A rebound falls kindly for Dodo (Fiorentina), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
8' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
7' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
3' Dodo (Fiorentina) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
1' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul after Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) hacks down one of his opponents.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
